capabilities._note: Text and a length only: no bpm, section or lyrics input, so a cue's arc is told as a story (prompt.py) and its tempo is written in the text. Measured on local ComfyUI 2026-11-01 (docs/SOUND.md 'Measured: Stable Audio 3 Medium'): an arc told as a story put the climax in place 6 of 8 seeds, the climax 18 dB over the intro, shape error median 0.36; a tempo in the text held within 0.5 % at 72 and 120 bpm, 4-7 % off at 92 (with a pulse). About 2 s a 52 s cue on an RTX 5090. Instrumental only.
